correctness.rationale: Wang's nesting H_j subset H_i for i<j makes every target profile downward closed. K3 is not in H_2, so its profile is empty. Proposition 7.7 gives M_{D,L} in H_D but not H_{D+1}; nestedness then gives exactly dimensions 2 through D. Theorem 1.4 gives K4 in every H_d. The Borel comparison is valid because continuous homomorphisms are Borel and the finite-target Borel criterion for d>1 is exactly nonbipartiteness.

value.rationale: The result is a natural complete classification of the possible dimension profiles of finite continuous targets. Its Borel refinement shows that every possible continuous cutoff occurs inside the same broad Borel-positive class of nonbipartite targets, isolating the hierarchy as genuinely continuous dimension sensitivity rather than a consequence of bipartiteness or Borel obstruction.
